cause: The remaining 21 parts caused a full composeRenderScene pass for the 1494-node deformer hierarchy each frame, despite only 680 part vertices using the general vertex path.

diagnostics.method: A separate Node seeded 120-frame trace instruments the existing math boundaries with process.hrtime.bigint. These phase times are not browser FPS measurements.
diagnostics.perPartLimitation: Independent part probes include shared selection and traversal work and must not be summed into a frame total.

changes: Retain the canonical parent-space surface and curve formulas inside owner-scoped compiled transform buffers.
Preserve copied parent point results when canonical surface handles retain more than one sample.
Compile independent document-space rotation paths and spatial parts after the existing 3D projection step.
Remove the full-scene reconstruction fallback for this model while retaining fallback for vertex-dependent and rebound rigs.
preserved: Model bytes, textures, meshes, keyforms, physics chains and outputs, motion data, render options.
Existing 3D projection, facing, depth order, curve interpolation, rotation inheritance and coordinate precision.
